name: Bermuda Lakes RV Resort
note: Motorhome-oriented resort: only Class A/B/C/Super C motorhomes and Airstream trailers are admitted, RVs over 10 years old need management approval with photos, and arrival is 2-5 pm only (late arrivals wait until morning). Also sells monthly and seasonal stays in fall-spring. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site bermudalakesrvresort.com (rv-sites, FAQ, rules pages read 2026-10-21): 155 full-hookup concrete-pad sites (pads at least 22x70 ft) in 4 nightly-priced types, Class C allowed, no tents/pop-ups; Newbook engine read 2026-10-21 for a 23-ft Class C sells a single night on Tue 11/10/2026, 1/12/2027, 2/16/2027 and 6/15/2027 with no application, and its category_sites_available shows 132-153 of 155 sites open by the night in Jan/Feb/Jun 2027 (24 on 11/10/2026) -> real transient RV resort, not a home community; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Operator site map (Site Map NEW Update 07-2026 PDF, read 2026-10-21) puts Premium Lakeside sites 107-125 along the west shore and 87-96 along the south shore of the park's own ~300 x 190 m retention lake (walking path on the north shore only). Esri World Imagery read 2026-10-21 (800 m and 300 m frames, both rendered): the west row's lakeside pads end ~13 m from the waterline across open, unused mowed grass with a few small shrubs, no path, road or treeline between; flat site, no dam or berm (DEM 6 m at the water). On-property man-made lake -> pond
fees_source: https://www.bermudalakesrvresort.com/the-resort/rv-sites read 2026-10-21: Signature Back-In (cheapest type) $129 Apr 1-May 31 and Oct 1-Nov 30, $159 Dec 1-Mar 31, summer from $89. Newbook engine read 2026-10-21, 23-ft Class C, 1 night: Tue 6/15/2027 Signature $89, Deluxe $99, Lakeside $119; Tue 11/10/2026 Signature $129; Tue 1/12/2027 Signature $159 (Deluxe $179, Lakeside $199); before tax, no resort fee shown
flags: Winter (Dec-Mar) base is $159/night for the cheapest site; summer $89, spring/fall $129. Included only because the price gate is lifted.
Newbook shows a '2 Night min' option on the Deluxe and Lakeside types in Nov/Jan, but the Signature type sells a single night on every date tried, so no booking.min_stay was set.

Waterfront 'pond' rests on the west-shore Premium Lakeside row (~13 m open grass to a ~5 ha on-property retention lake); 'lakefront' is the alternative reading if AWH counts a lake that size as a lake.
Rig rule: only motorhomes and Airstream trailers are admitted; the 10-year age rule needs photos for an exemption (EKKO is newer).
